title: ALL ( Product ) removes the filters on Product and keeps the filter on Date
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALL ( 'Product' ) ) ), 'Product'[Color] = "Red", 'Date'[Year] = 2024 )

source.quote: Removes all filters from the specified table.
source.supports: ALL ( Table ) removes the filters from the specified table only
in the page's last example ALL ( Product ) under filters on Product and Date gives the year's total, not the grand total

derivation: Removing the Color filter leaves Year = 2024: rows 5, 6, 7 = 200 + 30 + 100 = 330.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
